verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hosted chat web app, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents any telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking setting, or an opt-out for one. Self-hosted deployment and generic env/yaml configuration are not evidence of a telemetry opt-out, and community worries about future telemetry are speculation, not evidence either way.
